description: Demonstrates the optional orientation preset and speed parameters on relative_move and home. Uses relative_move from home rather than move_arm to a table-level object position, a full tilted_for_pour tilt right at table height is not reachable, the arm would have to intersect the table, so this lifts first and tilts at a safe height instead.

steps.description: Lift and tilt for pouring, at 30 percent speed
